designationHistory.indexText: Congress established New Philadelphia National Historic Site in Illinois, the first town known to have been planned and registered by a free African American before the Civil War, in the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023.

authority.citation: Public Law 117-328, div. DD, sec. 601, 136 Stat. 5601

designationHistory.note: The act uses 'there is established' with no acquisition condition. The description of the town follows the act's own purpose clause.
